deadline.value: Apply by January 1, 2027 (application, letters and test scores) for Fall 2027; ask for a fee grant by December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: The deadline to submit the application, letters of recommendation, and test scores for Fall admission is January 1st (in the same year of the Fall you are applying to).

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics Subject GRE is required for Fall 2027 applications.
gre_subject.quote: Changes for Fall 2027 Applications: Math GRE required

also.quote: The Subject GRE is required for applications.

supervisor.value: No advisor is needed to apply; you get an academic advisor on arrival and have until the end of your 6th semester to find a dissertation advisor.
supervisor.quote: No, you do not need an advisor prior to applying. Incoming students are assigned academic advisors at the beginning of their programs.

funding.value: Everyone offered PhD admission is also offered support (usually a TA), guaranteed for five years with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Students offered admission to the PhD program are also offered financial support, typically in the form of a teaching assistant position. This support is guaranteed for 5 years, assuming satisfactory progress.

entry_route.value: Successful applicants have a bachelor's in mathematics, applied mathematics or statistics.
entry_route.quote: Successful applicants have a bachelor’s degree in mathematics/applied mathematics/statistics.

fee_waiver.value: The department considers applicants for an application fee grant if you email the graduate program before submitting; request by December 1, 2026 (decisions by December 10).
fee_waiver.quote: then email grad_program@math.wisc.edu indicating your desire to be considered. | The deadline is December 1st. Decisions will be made by December 10th.

notes: Supplementary application asks for a detailed list of advanced maths courses.
